messages.subject: Multidimensional extension of the 3PLM
parts:
Hello everybody

I need to implement Multidimensional extension of the three-parameter logistic model (Reckase (2009), p 91) in 'mirt'.


Hear is my syntax, but i am not sure about it, specially "itemtype" option ("2PL" or "3PL") and "guess" option. any help?

m3pl <- mirt(dat, 2, itemtype="2PL",guess=c(0.048,0.002,0.128,0.158,0.26))

Best

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Multidimensional extension of the 3PLM
parts:
The guess input specifies the starting values for the g parameters. 2PL versus 3PL determines whether you want these parameters estimated (3PL) or fixed at these starting values (2PL). 

Phil
